hrtfpykit¶

hrtfpykit is a Python toolkit for SOFA-backed HRTF and HRIR workflows. It loads acoustic SOFA files, exposes HRTFs as processing objects, visualizes HRTF structure, and builds indexed datasets from public HRTF resources.

Documentation map¶

SOFA

Load, inspect, validate, edit, clone, and save SOFA files.

HRTF

Work with HRTF/HRIR objects, domain views, source grids, transforms, metrics, and spherical harmonics.

Plots

Visualize one HRTF or compare multiple HRTFs.

Datasets

Build spec-driven HUTUBS and SONICOM datasets.

Testing

Run the real-file and dataset integration tests.

Core imports¶

from hrtfpykit.sofa import load_sofa
from hrtfpykit.hrtf import load_hrtf
from hrtfpykit.datasets import HUTUBS, SONICOM, HRTFSpec

The root package currently exposes package metadata only. Use the subpackage imports above for user workflows.
